purpose: Study one predeclared cash-entry policy comparison for the confirmed after-close pullback question; this is not a current forecast or a claim of profitable timing

registration_basis.source_rationale: One observable down-close and one observable up-close directly operationalize the user’s premature re-entry/wait question with minimal new thresholds. W2 and other constants are design assumptions, not learned optima or evidence of advantage.

user_binding.first_use_case: 收盘后判断回落时该买入还是继续等待
user_binding.latest_parameter_state_file: 本轮用户确认与参数状态.json

scope.starting_research_sleeve: hypothetical flat cash sleeve only; actual account state unknown

research_constants.cash_return_model: zero nominal return, explicitly a research scenario not actual interest certification

time_and_population.session_clock: d0 is a planned SZSE open date known at its18:00 cutoff; d_j is the jth subsequent as-of planned session; missing/suspended stock bars do not shift the clock or T
time_and_population.eligibility: E(d0)=TRUE iff raw_close(d0)<raw_close(d_minus1), both field versions were available by d0_cutoff, both planned adjacent-session observations have certified comparable units and complete contemporaneous status/action evidence, no mechanical action distorts this adjacent-day comparison, and stock eligibility is certified
time_and_population.false_vs_unknown: Known non-pullback or known disallowed status is FALSE with reason; missing time/unit/status/action/previous-session price or uncertain eligibility is UNKNOWN, never FALSE
time_and_population.first_date_missing_previous_session: retain UNKNOWN; do not substitute prior observed stock bar or silently drop
time_and_population.mechanical_action_rule: Do not use any future d1..d10 event to exclude d0 retrospectively. Future corporate actions belong in the policy ledger; unknown required terms make affected wealth/targets unknown and coverage explicit
time_and_population.input_asof: version_first_available_at <= each policy decision_cutoff, and revised versions only after their actual availability; fetch timestamps in2026 are not historical availability
time_and_population.no_late_data_backfill: Late arrival after18:00 cannot become same-day input; preserve the original unknown/abstention and log later versions separately
time_and_population.label_maturity: label_mature_at=max(required realized/modelled fills, terminal mark, rights, accrued liabilities and all necessary validation timestamps); never train before actual maturity; unknown maturity remains unknown

A_now.limit_price: certified raw_close(d0), known at d0 cutoff

B_wait.confirmation: first j in{1,2} with certified comparable raw_close(dj)>raw_close(dj_minus1), known eligible status and no mechanical-action distortion at dj18:00; any earlier UNKNOWN makes first-confirmation history unresolved, never skip to a convenient later signal
B_wait.attempt_session: d_(j+1) after the first certified confirmation
B_wait.known_no_confirmation: cash path; status NO_TRIGGER, not a zero-return trade
B_wait.after_one_attempt_no_fill: cash path only if no-fill/cancellation certified; do not try again

C_cash.wealth: same initial10000 under declared nominal-zero-cash-return scenario

all_paths.common_terminal: T=d10 close, fixed from d0, never reset from later buy

order_and_wealth_contract.intended_order_window: one opening-auction limit attempt on the designated planned session, only if historical applicable venue/channel/order and cancellation rules are bound; no same-close or after-hours assumption
order_and_wealth_contract.quantity_formula: q_requested=max{100*k:k>=0, 100*k*limit_price+certified_order_time_fee_upper_bound(100*k,limit_price)<=available_cash}; if lot rule or fee bound is unknown then UNKNOWN, not q=0
order_and_wealth_contract.lot_rule_status: 100 is a research assumption; validate its historical applicability or fail the gate, never silently substitute
order_and_wealth_contract.partial_and_remaining: record each fill q_i,p_i,fees_i; remaining cash stays in the sleeve; remaining order cancellation requires a confirmed valid cancellation, otherwise unresolved; no overspend or repeat use of reserved cash
order_and_wealth_contract.counterfactual_fill_status: A/B fills cannot both be identified from daily bars or one actual account trade. A separately frozen and validated execution model must describe price/queue/no-fill/partial-fill/cancellation and label the result MODEL_BASED_COUNTERFACTUAL, never actual realized fills
order_and_wealth_contract.paid_fees_rule: cash already reflects paid charges; do not subtract twice
order_and_wealth_contract.dividend_rule: cash received and its receivable cannot both remain counted; receivables are not spendable cash before availability
order_and_wealth_contract.future_sale_fees: NAV endpoint has no invented sale; include only applicable accrued/unpaid liabilities, not a fictitious liquidating trade fee
order_and_wealth_contract.sellability: record historically lawful sellable quantity and restrictions separately; no assumption that fresh buys can be sold same-day; no purported guaranteed stops
order_and_wealth_contract.unknown_end_mark_with_positive_position: wealth and paired target NULL; do not forward-fill stale mark and certify it
order_and_wealth_contract.unknown_execution_fee_or_rights: affected wealth and paired target NULL, even if one path value is known
order_and_wealth_contract.T_plus_1_and_halts: use certified historical restrictions; no universal2026 rule backfill

labels_and_reporting.strict_paired_event: WAIT_HIGHER if delta>0; TIE if delta=0; NOW_HIGHER if delta<0; UNKNOWN if comparison unresolved; exact arithmetic/fee rounding follows validated money conventions, never hidden epsilon
labels_and_reporting.per_path_cash_relative: NAV_A/B(T)-NAV_C(T), with strict sign and amount; can lose money even if it wins the paired comparison
labels_and_reporting.nontrades: NO_TRIGGER/NO_ATTEMPT_BARRED/KNOWN_UNFILLED/KNOWN_ZERO_AFFORDABLE_QUANTITY are identified cash policies if every necessary condition is known; trade return itself remainsNULL when no trade
labels_and_reporting.unknown_vs_censored_vs_immature: store independent eligibility, confirmation, order, terminal, label-maturity states; no single0 code
labels_and_reporting.denominators: keep all planned d0 dates, eligibility false/unknown, entered/not-triggered/barred/unfilled/partial/unresolved/censored/immature counts; main paired frequency denominator is only E=TRUE and both terminal paths identified under the declared execution model; disclose loss of coverage and missingness selection
required_outputs: A/B/C terminal NAV and relative-to-cash amounts
daily close-mark NAV downside and drawdown only if each mark certified; not intraday guaranteed risk
coverage by date/month and each unresolved reason
all negative/zero/missing results; no winner-quarter selection
labels_and_reporting.phase1_acceptance: This first candidate is definition-only now. Any later phase1 run is descriptive paired-policy research only; no success threshold, model promotion or current action can follow from selecting a positive development mean
labels_and_reporting.future_predictive_acceptance: Separate preregistration must fix the predictive model/estimator, training schedule, sample minimum, clustered uncertainty, economic margin, calibration and promotion criteria before any real forecast fitting/scoring. Until that binding, do not claim a fully executable prediction protocol
time_order_requirements: training contains only targets with label_mature_at earlier than its training cutoff
purge all training outcome windows crossing evaluation starts
overlapping outcomes are dependent; never count them as independent trials
shared paired cohort and missingness disclosed
2023/2024 already seen; no fresh independent-test claim
2025/2026 stay closed until separately registered later-stage agreement

required_before_any_real_target: selected raw_close mapping/unit/version/historical availability bound with actual source evidence
as-of calendar, adjacent-session observations and individual stock eligibility/status certified
history-applicable quantity, venue, order and cancellation model bound
counterfactual execution model frozen with assumptions and independent validation
fees, rights, cash/receivables/liabilities fully bound for declared use
population/entry/terminal/maturity states and full missingness ledger implemented and independently reviewed
explicit separately saved experimental run registration and permission gate before label calculation; no automatic run on design completion
change_control: Protocol body and canonical SHA frozen before labels. Any H/W/cohort/confirmation/order/endpoint/estimator change gets a new version and research-choice entry, preserves negatives, and cannot be chosen from same-batch outcomes.
